newsitem.title: GERMANY: German officials say five mln Feb jobless unlikely.
newsitem.headline: German officials say five mln Feb jobless unlikely.

text.p: Officials at the Federal Labour Office and the Federation of German Trade Unions (DGB) said on Tuesday it was unlikely that unemployment would surge again in February to hit the five million mark.

A labour office spokesman said it was "rather improbable" that the increase in unemployment would hit five million in February. The rise in joblessness could even slow because of the sharp increase in January, he said.
A DGB official said mild weather could also have had a positive effect, but that no one could rule out any surprises in the figures to be announced next week.
German unemployment surged to 4.66 million in January, or 12.2 percent, the highest level since the Great Depression of the 1930s.
